## 2. Project Case Studies

### 2.1 EduSathi (AI Study Companion)
- **What it is**: Production-grade AI study companion designed specifically for university students.
- **Architecture**: 4-stage RAG pipeline utilizing high-speed PDF ingestion, recursive text chunking, FAISS dense vector similarity search, and Groq LLaMA models configured to answer strictly based on retrieved context. Includes dual-portal RBAC for admins and students.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, LangChain, FAISS, Groq API (LLaMA 3.1), Streamlit, PyPDF2.
- **Author**: Mohammed Muzammil C
- **First-party URL**: [EduSathi Case Study](https://muzzyy.me/projects/edusaathi)
- **Repository**: [EduSathi Repo](https://github.com/not-muzzyy/EduSathi-Production-Grade-RAG-Based-AI-Study-Companion)

### 2.2 Mini-SIEM AI
- **What it is**: AI-powered Security Information and Event Management system.
- **Architecture**: Ingests real-time logs, uses an ensemble ML classifier to dynamically flag attack vectors (replacing static regex), calculates SHAP feature contribution values to prove why an alert triggered, and uses Groq LLaMA 3.1 to synthesize technical data into narrative incident reports.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Streamlit, Scikit-learn, SHAP, Pandas, Groq API (LLaMA).
- **Author**: Mohammed Muzammil C
- **First-party URL**: [Mini-SIEM AI Case Study](https://muzzyy.me/projects/mini-siem-ai)
- **Repository**: [Mini-SIEM AI Repo](https://github.com/not-muzzyy/mini-siem-ai)

### 2.3 Phishing Detector Advanced
- **What it is**: 4-layer cybersecurity pipeline evaluating URLs, HTML emails, and text for phishing probabilty.
- **Architecture**: Multilingual NLP processing for English, Hindi, and Hinglish. Extracts 20+ structural and domain-age features from URLs, using optimized Scikit-learn algorithms.
- **Results**: Reports 97% accuracy, 96% precision, 97% recall, and 97% F1 on the project's evaluated test set.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NLTK, Streamlit.
- **Author**: Mohammed Muzammil C
- **First-party URL**: [Phishing Detector Case Study](https://muzzyy.me/projects/phishing-detector)
- **Repository**: [Phishing Detector Repo](https://github.com/not-muzzyy/phishing-detector-advanced)

### 2.4 Virtual Pollution Intelligence Grid
- **What it is**: Interactive geospatial monitoring dashboard.
- **Architecture**: Real-time overlay of pollution metrics mapped dynamically using Folium. 7-Day ML-powered risk forecasting, and a scenario simulation engine allowing users to alter variables to visualize hypothetical impacts. Built at Chakravyuha 3.0 Hackathon.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Streamlit, Pandas, Folium, Plotly, Scikit-learn.
- **Author**: Mohammed Muzammil C
- **First-party URL**: [Pollution Intel Grid Case Study](https://muzzyy.me/projects/virtual-pollution-grid)
- **Repository**: [Pollution Intel Grid Repo](https://github.com/not-muzzyy/virtual-pollution-intelligence-grid)
